First, we cancel any terms that appear in both a numerator and a denominator. Then, we multiply the numerators and the denominators as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{(n+1)(n+3)}{4{n}^{2}}\cdot \frac{8n}{(n+3)(n-2)} & =\frac{(n+1)\cancel{(n+3)}}{\cancel{4n}\cdot n}\cdot \frac{2\cdot \cancel{4n}}{\cancel{(n+3)}(n-2)} \\  & =\frac{n+1}{n}\cdot \frac{2}{n-2} \\  & =\frac{2n+2}{{n}^{2}-2n}\end{aligned}
$$
